class MovingAverage:
    def __init__(self, size: int):
        self.arr = [0] * size
        self.s = 0
        self.cnt = 0

    def next(self, val: int) -> float:
        idx = self.cnt % len(self.arr)
        self.s += val - self.arr[idx]
        self.arr[idx] = val
        self.cnt += 1
        return self.s / min(self.cnt, len(self.arr))
